Death to the False Emperor!

Battle Cry of the Discilan Apostates
forces: - chaos-traitor - imperial-navy - titan-legion using_the_army_list: | The following army list allows you to field a Chaos Traitor army based on the Discilan Apostates that took part in Abaddon’s 13th Crusade. It can also be used as a stand in army list for other Chaos Traitor armies. Chaos Traitor formations come in two types: _contingents_ and _support formations_. Each contingent you include in the army allows you to field any two support formations. Although you can only take a support formation if you first take a contingent, they are treated as separate independent formations during the battle and do not have to move around together. In addition, contingent formations may be given upgrades. Daemonic Pact and up to four other upgrades may be taken once per formation. Upgrades are added to the formation and are not a separate formation. Each upgrade that is taken adds to the cost of the formation, as shown on the upgrade chart. Note that if an upgrade allows you to take multiple units it still only counts as one upgrade towards the formation's four upgrade limit when you take multiple units (e.g. three Defilers would count as one upgrade). Chaos Traitor armies may be supported by Chaos Traitor Navy assets and Chaos Traitor Titan battlegroups. A maximum of up to a third of the points available to the army may be spent on these formations. Finally, each Chaos Traitor army may field up to two Plague Zombie Infestations and contain a Daemon Pool. special_rules_text: | Certain units have special abilities described in _Augmented Summoning_ (see [_Augmented Summoning_](#augmented-summoning)) and _Daemonic Focus_ (see [_Daemonic Focus_](#daemonic-focus)). special_rules: - discilan-apostates-epic-tournament-special-rules - fickle-masters - summoned-units ---

Discilan Apostates Chaos Traitor armies have a strategy rating of 2. Possessed and Chaos Traitor Titan battlegroup formations have an initiative rating of 1+. All other formations have an initiative rating of 2+.
